brief: Trims a list: empty items at its ends, a given item at its ends, blank texts throughout, runs of blanks, or everything past a size.
detail: Build one with new stzListTrimmer(aList) or over a stzList object; it keeps its own copy, so what you passed in is not changed, and Content gives the result. Each verb that changes the list has a passive twin that returns a trimmed copy instead (Trim and Trimmed, Compact and Compacted ...). Empty, for Trim, TrimLeft and TrimRight, means the number 0, an empty or blank text, an empty sublist or a false object, so a list of numbers loses its zeros at the ends; Compact, Squeeze and StripNulls look at texts and sublists only. The Q forms (TrimQ, CompactQ ...) return the trimmer to chain on.
